name: neweditor-ai
description: NewEditor.AI — agente editor de vídeo da NewContent + Editor Brain

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/core/src/*.test.ts apps/web/src/lib/*.test.ts apps/desktop/src/*.test.ts && npm run test:server
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build -w @neweditor/web && npm run start -w @neweditor/desktop
